issues.legal_issue: Buildings used to provide facilities necessary for the welfare or efficiency of factory workers are used for the purpose of a factory.
material_facts: The assessed properties included rooms used by mill employees for indoor games, a guards’ club, an officers’ club, workers’ residential quarters, and 200 quarters allotted to factory workers.
The Court found that allotting these buildings for workers’ use was necessary for their welfare and efficiency.
The factories carried on a manufacturing process involving power for the required continuous period, and the buildings were owned by the factory proprietors.
The buildings were not outside-compound godowns or houses intended for or occupied by managerial or superior staff.
issues.conclusion: The buildings were used for the purpose of a factory and qualified on that ground for the statutory exemption.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 4(g) of the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940, read with rule 18(1) and rule 18(4) of the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Rules, 1941, factory-purpose use includes use required for a factory to function in accordance with factory law and use necessary to maintain the efficiency of machinery or factory workers. The Court referred to sections 42, 43, 46, 47, 48 and 92 of the Factories Act, 1948, as examples of legally required worker facilities, and to London Co-operative Society Ltd. v. Southern Essex Assessment Committee, [1942] 1 K.B. 53, as illustrating the relevance of worker welfare and efficiency.

rule.if: factory_property_tax_exemption_case and factory_owned_building and powered_manufacturing_continues and (required_for_factory_to_function or necessary_for_worker_or_machine_efficiency) and not excluded_building_type

predicates.factory_property_tax_exemption_case: The dispute concerns whether a building is exempt from property tax as used for the purpose of a factory.
predicates.factory_owned_building: The building is owned by the proprietor of the factory.
predicates.powered_manufacturing_continues: The factory carries on a manufacturing process involving power for the required continuous period.
predicates.required_for_factory_to_function: The building is used for a facility that factory law requires for the factory to function.
predicates.necessary_for_worker_or_machine_efficien: The building is used for something necessary to maintain the efficiency of the factory’s workers or machinery.
predicates.excluded_building_type: The building is a type excluded from the exemption, such as an outside-compound godown or a house intended for or occupied by managerial or superior staff.

issues.definition: When a factory-owned building in a factory property-tax exemption case supports qualifying powered manufacturing, is not an excluded type, and provides something required for factory operation or necessary for worker or machine efficiency, it qualifies as used for factory purpose.

issues.legal_issue: Payments made by factory employees who occupy buildings as licensees are not rent for the purpose of the factory-property exemption exclusion.
material_facts: The assessed properties were allowed to be used by employees on a leave-and-license basis.
The employees made payments in respect of that use.
issues.conclusion: The employees’ payments were not rent within the meaning of the rule’s exclusion, so they did not prevent the buildings from receiving the exemption.
issues.legal_principle: Rule 18(4)(ii) of the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Rules, 1941, excludes buildings for which rent is charged. In context, including the use of “rent” in sections 5 and 14 of the Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1940, rent means payment by a tenant to a landlord for demised property; it does not include payments by licensees. The Court noted that later amendments to sections 4(d) and 4(e) could not determine the meaning of a rule framed earlier.

predicates.factory_property_tax_exemption_case: The dispute concerns whether a building is exempt from property tax as used for the purpose of a factory.
predicates.occupants_hold_as_licensees: The occupants use the building under a licence rather than as tenants holding demised property.
predicates.occupants_pay_for_use: The occupants make payments in respect of their use of the building.

issues.definition: In a factory property-tax exemption case, payments for use by occupants holding as licensees are not rent when those occupants pay for that use.
